item.title: CHECKLIST: Everything you need to do when you move house in Sweden
item.description: Whether you're moving to a new rented apartment or have bought your home, there are lots of things to keep track of to help the move go smoothly.

item.title: What can you do with your kids in Sweden before term starts again?
item.description: You might already be back at work after the Christmas break, but your kids aren’t necessarily back at school yet. What can you do with them during the rest of the holidays to keep them occupied?

item.title: Tax cuts, longer citizenship waits and an election: What changes in Sweden in 2026
item.description: Sweden's government is bringing in far-reaching tax cuts, lower daycare fees, an increase in the wait for citizenship to 8 years, and on top of all that, there's a general election. Here's what's happening in Sweden in 2026.

item.title: New laws, holidays and awards: What changes in Sweden in January 2026?
item.description: Re-emigration grants came into force on January 1st, as well as a number of tax cuts which should give you more money in your pocket in 2026.

item.title: 'Don't miss out': Why Brits in Europe should upgrade their post-Brexit residence permits
item.description: It’s been five years since the end of the post-Brexit transition period and for many British citizens living in the EU this means 2026 will be the time to upgrade to a permanent residence cards. But what happens if forget or leave it late?

item.title: Sweden issues three-day weather warnings due to snow and wind
item.description: Many parts of the country have already been hit by heavy snowfall and winds in recent days, and there's no sign of things slowing down yet, with new weather warnings issued for the coming weekend.

item.title: 'Sweden is my children’s country': Health professionals ordered to leave after years of work
item.description: Zahra Kazemipour and Afshad Joubeh, both assistant nurses, are due to be deported from Sweden along with their two children after a government decision to abolish the rule which allowed them to stay in the country.

item.description: Here's a delicious word well worth knowing if you're dining out in Sweden.

item.description: Plenty of Scandinavian brands have made it overseas, but did you realise these companies have Nordic origins?

item.title: How to dispose of your Christmas tree in Sweden
item.description: Dumping your Christmas tree on the street can result in a hefty fine, so make sure you dispose of it responsibly.
